This part is fully supported by the text: 'Analytic approaches... being vector-oriented, these techniques are resolution-independent' and 'pixel-based methods... are faster and simpler to implement' and mentions 'G-buffers' (image-space buffers). Because one part of the claim is supported and the other (the specific comparative distinction of 'this family') is not supported or is a misinterpretation of the general survey, the verdict is partial.
